description: Buy the ticket for a flight from search_flights, paid in USDC. Call it first without payment to get the price, wallet address and MPP challenges. After sending the USDC, call it again with tx_hash and chain (or an MPP credential in _meta "org.paymentauth/credential"). x402 clients can instead sign one of the offers in error.data.x402 and retry with the PaymentPayload in _meta "x402/payment", with no gas needed. Returns the ticket link and PDF.

chain.description: Chain the USDC was sent on, defaults to base

email.description: Optional, also emails the ticket here

first_name.description: Passenger's first name, as on their passport

last_name.description: Passenger's last name, as on their passport

tx_hash.description: Hash of the USDC transfer that paid for it

name: buy_ticket
title: Buy onward ticket
